nom: Origins Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel with Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/acne-prone skin report the gel clears blemishes overnight to within a few days and one notes it made her skin softer and less oily, though one oily-skin reviewer found it dried out her skin badly.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report burning, tingling, stinging or an allergic reaction with red dots that persisted after stopping use, while others with sensitive skin say it works without irritation and gently clears spots.
segments.combination: One combination-skin reviewer reports it clears blemishes gently with no residue or burning and does not dry out her skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her early 30s and one at 38 report continued use for hormonal and adult acne with good results, treating it as a routine part of a mature/adult skincare regimen.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report individual pimples or whiteheads shrinking or disappearing within one night to a few days; a minority report no visible change in size or discoloration even after weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers describe cystic, hormonal, or mask-related breakouts clearing up faster with overnight or few-day results; a few report the product did nothing or made a fresh pimple redder and more swollen the next morning.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visible reduction in redness and swelling around a blemish overnight; one reports the opposite, with a pimple becoming more red and enlarged after application.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the product made her skin feel softer and less oily over time; this is not corroborated elsewhere.
concerns.aging: One reviewer in her 30s reports her skin looking more even-toned and lighter around the mouth and under the eyes after two weeks of use.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers report the product stings, tingles, or burns on application, with a few describing lasting allergic-type reactions (persistent red dots) even after discontinuing use.

aspects.libelle: Fast overnight results on fresh spots
Small bottle lasts a long time
